headline: Dollar Holds Range Before US Midterms as Bitcoin Drops After Crypto Heist
summary: The US dollar traded within a tight range ahead of midterm elections, while bitcoin slipped following a reported cryptocurrency heist.
why: The US dollar reflects macroeconomic and political expectations surrounding US legislative control, while digital assets remain vulnerable to security breaches.
